source.source_name: Companies House — PSC snapshot (persons with significant control)
source.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (Companies House)

parsing.notes: Daily snapshot of PSC records (one JSON object per line, with company_number + data{}). Resolve the latest snapshot file from en_pscdata.html. Personal data — minimise/redact individual name/DOB/nationality; retain control bands + corporate PSCs.

mapping_rules.owners: Map PSC records to owners[]: name (redact individuals), kind, natures_of_control (control bands). Join on company_number.

live_test_plan.smoke: Parse first 1000 PSC lines; assert company_number + natures_of_control; verify PII minimisation.
live_test_plan.full: Daily snapshot load to owners[] keyed on company_number with PII minimisation.

blockers: Personal data (PSC individuals) — redaction + lawful basis required.
